strings.tm.title: Mictlan Temple
strings.tm.tagline: Freshly graduated, you travel to Mexico to study a still poorly understood zone. Beneath the stone, you discover the buried temple of the Lady of the Dead.
strings.tm.s01.title: Fresh Diploma in Hand
strings.tm.s01.body: You arrive in Mexico with a small contract and one huge obsession: an anomaly spotted on survey data. No one really believes in your “temple” — except you.
strings.tm.s01.c2: Go see the site right away
strings.tm.s01.c3: Read through the notes and map again
strings.tm.s02.title: The Camp
strings.tm.s02.body: Tents, crates, tools. The chairs are empty, but the place still holds a presence. Someone points out a hill that “sounds hollow” when the wind blows.
strings.tm.s02.c1: Question the team about the hill
strings.tm.s03.title: The Dust Trail
strings.tm.s03.body: The path narrows. The heat clings to you. With every step, your boots leave marks that are too sharp, as if someone had already passed through here before you.
strings.tm.s03.c2: Mark reference points on the ground
strings.tm.s04.title: The Stone That Echoes
strings.tm.s04.body: Beneath a thin layer of dirt, a slab. You strike it: a hollow, deep sound. Not a cave… more like a constructed void. A sealed void.
strings.tm.s04.c1: Clear the area with the trowel
strings.tm.s05.title: The Opening
strings.tm.s05.body: Beneath the roots, a carved slab appears. The patterns do not match anything cataloged. And yet… you have the feeling you’ve seen them before, without knowing where.
strings.tm.s05.c3: Cover it back up and return with help
strings.tm.s06.title: First Breath of Air
strings.tm.s06.body: The slab moves. Cold air comes out, carrying the scent of extinguished incense. This is not the smell of an abandoned place: it is the smell of a sealed place.
strings.tm.s06.c2: Leave a makeshift rope as a marker and test the ground
strings.tm.s06.c3: Return to camp if you can make yourself do it
strings.tm.s07.title: The Low Corridor
strings.tm.s07.body: You move forward bent over. The rock is black, almost glassy. On the walls, finger marks… fresh, in ancient dust.
strings.tm.s07.c2: Avoid them and stay in the center
strings.tm.s08.title: The First Symbol
strings.tm.s08.body: A glyph shows an open mouth swallowing. Your stomach tightens. You tell yourself it is only a symbol. But your body does not agree.
strings.tm.s08.c2: Write down the glyph in your notebook
strings.tm.s08.c3: Step back to the last “safe” place
strings.tm.s09.title: Room of Forgotten Tools
strings.tm.s09.body: A niche. Ancient tools, arranged as if someone were about to come back. In front of them, a small pouch of salt, placed far too deliberately to be random.
strings.tm.s09.c2: Leave the salt and quickly inspect the niche
strings.tm.s10.title: The Silence That Answers
strings.tm.s10.body: You stop. The silence is so heavy that it feels like it answers you. Your light shines on… a bend in the corridor that was not there earlier.
strings.tm.s11.title: Basalt Staircase
strings.tm.s11.body: Steps cut clean. They descend into a darkness so thick it almost feels solid. Moisture, pale fragments on the floor… and that smell: earth and bone.
strings.tm.s11.c2: Go down fast to stop thinking about it
strings.tm.s11.c3: Go back up, you have no backup
strings.tm.s12.title: The First Door
strings.tm.s12.body: A stone door. No handle. Only a hollow shaped like an obsidian shard. A lock without metal. It is waiting for one precise object.
strings.tm.s12.c1: Search around, in the alcoves, on the floor, and in the cracks
strings.tm.s12.c3: Insert the obsidian into the hollow
strings.tm.s13.title: Alcoves and Skulls
strings.tm.s13.body: Skulls lined up, flawless, almost polished. In some eye sockets: jade beads. Everything is arranged too carefully to belong to a place dead for so long.
strings.tm.s13.c3: Study the walls for a clue
strings.tm.s14.title: Corridor of Offerings
strings.tm.s14.body: Broken pottery, carefully arranged bones. A codex page, trapped beneath a stone, intact — as if the damp had spared it on purpose.
strings.tm.s14.c2: Memorize the symbols and move on
strings.tm.s15.title: The Door Resists
strings.tm.s15.body: You return to the door. The obsidian-shaped hollow seems… deeper. As if the temple had changed it while you were away.
strings.tm.s15.c1: Insist on understanding without forcing it
strings.tm.s16.title: The Obsidian Shard
strings.tm.s16.body: In a crack, an obsidian shard, deliberately shaped. When you hold it, you feel the tiniest warmth at your fingertips.
strings.tm.s16.c2: Test it on the door immediately
strings.tm.s16.c3: Put it back out of caution
strings.tm.s17.title: The Door Gives Way
strings.tm.s17.body: The shard slides in. A click echoes through the stone. The door glides open silently, as if its weight had never mattered.
strings.tm.s17.c3: Go warn the camp before entering
strings.tm.s18.title: Gallery of Frescoes
strings.tm.s18.body: Procession murals: faceless figures, offerings of bone, teeth, and hair. At the far end, a “crowned” figure watches without eyes.
strings.tm.s18.c3: Step back, it is too much information all at once
strings.tm.s19.title: The Echo
strings.tm.s19.body: The tunnel repeats your footsteps with a slight delay, like another walker copying your pace. A puddle trembles… though nothing drips into it.
strings.tm.s19.c3: Turn off the flashlight for one second to test it
strings.tm.s20.title: The Breathing Crack
strings.tm.s20.body: In the stone: a crack venting cold mist. Not a normal draft. More like… breathing.
strings.tm.s20.c2: Sprinkle a little salt if you have some
strings.tm.s21.title: Black Basin
strings.tm.s21.body: A basin of still, dark water. Its surface reflects your face… with a one-second delay. The calm feels like a threat.
strings.tm.s22.title: The Walkway
strings.tm.s22.body: A narrow passage hangs over the black water. The stones are wet. One slip here feels like a sentence.
strings.tm.s23.title: The False Reflection
strings.tm.s23.body: The black surface lies: the reflected ceiling does not match what your light reveals. The place is creating an image… to deceive you.
strings.tm.s23.c2: Put some salt at the edge if you have any
strings.tm.s24.title: The Smell of Salt
strings.tm.s24.body: Salt on the wet stone: the crystals shine and the mist slows, as if it has hit a boundary.
strings.tm.s24.c1: Draw a small circle of salt to reassure yourself
strings.tm.s24.c2: Keep going without wasting the salt
strings.tm.s25.title: The Descending Ramp
strings.tm.s25.body: The slope leads you lower. The air grows colder. Every step echoes as if the temple were counting your every move.
strings.tm.s26.title: The Breath Behind You
strings.tm.s26.body: The mist moves against the current. As if something were trying to stay right behind you.
strings.tm.s26.c3: Go back to the last fork
strings.tm.s27.title: Room of Polished Bones
strings.tm.s27.body: Bones arranged too neatly, some polished like ivory. Nothing here has been left to chance. Everything seems sorted by a rule.
strings.tm.s28.title: The Small Obsidian Knife
strings.tm.s28.body: A small obsidian knife, placed like a key. Your hand knows immediately: this is what the door is waiting for.
strings.tm.s28.c2: Leave it and risk regretting it
strings.tm.s28.c3: Test it on the door right away
strings.tm.s29.title: The Heart of the Temple
strings.tm.s29.body: A great chamber finally opens. Basalt columns, low mist. Far ahead: the shape of an altar. The scale of the place makes you dizzy.
strings.tm.s29.c2: First observe the sides, the exits, and the traps
strings.tm.s30.title: The Altar Room
strings.tm.s30.body: An obsidian altar, black and damp. Circular hollows like sockets. The floor reflects a cold light that should not exist here.
strings.tm.s30.c2: Step back and breathe more quietly
strings.tm.s31.title: The Ordered Charnel Wall
strings.tm.s31.body: A wall of bone and stone, stacked like bricks. Everything is too precise. Too clean. As if an invisible hand still maintains the place.
strings.tm.s31.c1: Follow the wall and look for a door
strings.tm.s31.c3: Sprinkle salt at the base of the wall if you have some
strings.tm.s32.title: The Motionless Presence
strings.tm.s32.body: The room is empty… but the mist stops dead, as if waiting for an order. The shadows are thicker in certain corners.
strings.tm.s33.title: The Sound of Beads
strings.tm.s33.body: Jade beads, as if they had just rolled. One alone bears fresh dust. Something is playing with you.
strings.tm.s34.title: The Codex Insists
strings.tm.s34.body: The page, a bone, and a bead form a pattern that looks like an instruction. It is not a text. It is a rule shown through objects.
strings.tm.s34.c1: Follow the rule and place the objects first
strings.tm.s34.c2: Refuse, you are not playing this game
strings.tm.s35.title: The Rising Mist
strings.tm.s35.body: The mist rises toward you. Not like smoke… like something targeting you. You feel pressure around your mouth.
strings.tm.s35.c1: Draw a circle of salt if you have some
strings.tm.s36.title: The Side Passage
strings.tm.s36.body: Behind a damaged panel, a narrow passage. Scuff marks in the dust: someone comes through here… sometimes.
strings.tm.s37.title: The Wall of Teeth
strings.tm.s37.body: The stone forms interlocking “teeth.” You realize it is not decorative: it can tighten… very slowly.
strings.tm.s37.c2: Test the joints with a little salt
strings.tm.s37.c3: Go back to the side passage
strings.tm.s38.title: The Threshold
strings.tm.s38.body: A threshold darker than the rest. The mist gathers there. On the ground: a bone fragment and greenish jade dust.
strings.tm.s38.c3: Call out and listen to the warped echo
strings.tm.s39.title: Room of Sealed Jars
strings.tm.s39.body: Jars sealed with resin. One is cracked. A cold breath comes from it, like a trapped sigh.
strings.tm.s39.c2: Check the crack with salt if you have any
strings.tm.s40.title: The Freed Breath
strings.tm.s40.body: At the slightest contact, a current of air rushes up your arm. As if something were trying to enter through your skin. You pull your hand back at once.
strings.tm.s41.title: Gallery of Names
strings.tm.s41.body: Walls carved with lines that look like names. Some places have been erased: the stone is whiter there, as if something had been rubbed away.
strings.tm.s42.title: Your Name Is Not There
strings.tm.s42.body: You do not find your name. But you see a half-carved line, as if something still has to be added there. And you feel as though that emptiness is watching you.
strings.tm.s42.c2: Sprinkle a little salt on the line
strings.tm.s43.title: The Door of Offerings
strings.tm.s43.body: A door with several impressions. You recognize the shapes of a ritual. You understand that you must pay with the right objects, not just push forward.
strings.tm.s43.c3: Go back to the altar room
strings.tm.s44.title: Living Mechanism
strings.tm.s44.body: When you bring the objects near the slots, the stone vibrates. Dust trembles. The temple no longer feels like a simple building. It seems to be waiting for each of your gestures.
strings.tm.s44.c3: Back away and breathe as little as possible
strings.tm.s45.title: Room of the Vertical Shaft
strings.tm.s45.body: A shaft descends into darkness. A rope is tied there… very old, yet oddly clean to the touch. As if it had been “prepared” for you.
strings.tm.s45.c2: Shine your light down and listen
strings.tm.s45.c3: Go back to the gallery of names
strings.tm.s46.title: The Glowing Skulls
strings.tm.s46.body: Skull alcoves. Some seem to glow from within, just enough to make you doubt your flashlight. This place does not like attention.
strings.tm.s47.title: The Stone Bridge
strings.tm.s47.body: A narrow bridge above a black void. The stone is slick. Every step feels like a silent negotiation.
strings.tm.s48.title: The Choice of the Void
strings.tm.s48.body: At the edge, you look down: black, too black. A drop falls… and you never hear it land. Everything here seems built to make you dizzy.
strings.tm.s48.c3: Put down salt if you have some, then step back
strings.tm.s49.title: Back to the Altar
strings.tm.s49.body: You see the altar again from a distance. The mist is thicker. The altar looks sharper, as if it recognizes you. As if it has truly been waiting for you.
strings.tm.s49.c3: Look for a sign of the Lady
strings.tm.s50.title: The Obsidian Altar
strings.tm.s50.body: Up close, the circular hollows look like mouths. The reflections make you think they are moving. Here, the rule of breath becomes real.
strings.tm.s50.c1: Place objects if you have any
strings.tm.s50.c3: Look for the seal in the ritual room
strings.tm.s51.title: The Queen of Bones
strings.tm.s51.body: The architecture gives the impression of a throne made of bones. No visible body. And yet, you feel an authority watching you like prey.
strings.tm.s52.title: The Hunger
strings.tm.s52.body: The mist pulls toward the altar like a sucking force. You understand that your breath could serve as the price to pay. Your instinct screams: do not give it.
strings.tm.s53.title: Offering the Page
strings.tm.s53.body: Your hand places the page near a socket. The edges tremble beneath an invisible current of air. The temple “reads” without eyes.
strings.tm.s54.title: Offering the Bead
strings.tm.s54.body: The bead above a hollow. It catches a cold light. For one second, the mist pulls back — as if before a rule.
strings.tm.s55.title: The Fresco Comes Alive
strings.tm.s55.body: The painted procession seems closer. Dust outlines recent shapes. It is not exactly movement, but you can feel something drawing nearer.
strings.tm.s55.c2: Go back to the corridor of offerings
strings.tm.s55.c3: Go to the names to choose one
strings.tm.s56.title: The Lady of the Dead
strings.tm.s56.body:
You do not see a face. Only a throne-shaped form made of bones. Yet the room reacts as if someone were sitting there.

Behind the seat, hanging vertebrae move ever so slightly, as if a breath were passing through them.
strings.tm.s56.c3: Look for the exit through the seal
strings.tm.s57.title: The Altar Demands
strings.tm.s57.body: The hollows seem darker. The mist streams toward them like toward mouths. You have the feeling that the temple wants the objects you carry.
strings.tm.s58.title: The Folding Corridor
strings.tm.s58.body: The corridor seems shorter than before. The arches no longer line up. The temple appears to shorten or stretch the passages to keep you from leaving.
strings.tm.s58.c1: Force your way and keep moving anyway
strings.tm.s59.title: The Cold Mark
strings.tm.s59.body: A cold trace slips onto you, like a signature without ink. You understand that the place can mark you without touching you directly.
strings.tm.s60.title: The Door Opens a Crack
strings.tm.s60.body: A door opens a crack. An obsidian mechanism lines up. Fresh dust reveals a recent passage. An exit… or another trap.
strings.tm.s61.title: The Eyeless Gaze
strings.tm.s61.body:
Shapes in the stone look like empty eye sockets turned toward you. There is no creature. And yet, you feel watched. Your breathing suddenly feels too loud.

With every breath, the arches seem to draw a little closer.
strings.tm.s61.c2: Put down salt if you have any
strings.tm.s62.title: The Return Altar
strings.tm.s62.body: You see the altar again. New fine cracks have appeared. A dark shard juts out from the stone. It looks as if your hesitation has strengthened the place.
strings.tm.s63.title: The Seal Room
strings.tm.s63.body: A slab engraved with a seal. Four symbols echo the prepared ritual. At the center: a handprint.
strings.tm.s63.c1: Place the objects on the seal
strings.tm.s63.c2: Put your hand on the imprint
strings.tm.s63.c3: Go back, you are not ready
strings.tm.s64.title: The Weight of the Choice
strings.tm.s64.body: The handprint seems damp. Mist coils around it as if being sucked in. The rule is simple: to get out, you must offer a name, not just a key.
strings.tm.s64.c2: Refuse the pact and look for another way out
strings.tm.s65.title: The Ossuary Inside You
strings.tm.s65.body:
You have the feeling that the temple has kept an imprint of you. You must decide quickly, before it decides in your place.

Already, pressure tightens around your throat: if you wait even a few more seconds, you will no longer know whether your next choice still comes from you.
strings.tm.s65.c3: Return to the Lady to negotiate
strings.tm.s66.title: The Rule of Breath
strings.tm.s66.body: The page, laid down like a law: name in exchange for exit. Breath in exchange for damnation. If you give your breath, you become one more bone in the temple.
strings.tm.s66.c1: Apply the rule, offer a name, and keep your breath
strings.tm.s67.title: Choose a Name
strings.tm.s67.body: The carved lines are unreadable, but certain areas “catch” the light. You can offer your own… or take someone else’s.
strings.tm.s67.c2: Look for a name that seems to protect you
strings.tm.s68.title: Steal a Name
strings.tm.s68.body: One line seems to glow faintly. Your finger hesitates. You feel a real moral weight… and something ancient waiting for your gesture.
strings.tm.s69.title: The Erased Name
strings.tm.s69.body: An erasure leaves an empty place. If you complete it, the temple accepts it. You sense that something is waiting inside that emptiness.
strings.tm.s70.title: Back to the Seal
strings.tm.s70.body: The room seems smaller. The seal looks sharper. As if the decision is feeding it. You must activate it… or flee.
strings.tm.s70.c1: Activate the seal with the chosen name
strings.tm.s70.c3: Return to the Lady for one last negotiation
strings.tm.s71.title: Negotiate with the Lady of the Dead
strings.tm.s71.body: You speak. The bones “answer” with a faint clatter. She listens… but promises nothing. This place gives no gifts.
strings.tm.s71.c2: Lie and say you will come back with more
strings.tm.s72.title: The Offering of Objects
strings.tm.s72.body: If you place the page, the bead, and the obsidian down, the room calms for one second. But the hunger returns at once. You must use the brief opening.
strings.tm.s72.c2: Complete the seal and take the clean exit
strings.tm.s72.c3: Take your objects back despite the risk
strings.tm.s73.title: The Lie
strings.tm.s73.body: You promise to come back. The temple “accepts.” You feel a cold mark: a contract.
strings.tm.s73.c2: Stay and look for a real exit
strings.tm.s73.c3: Stay silent and breathe as little as possible
strings.tm.s74.title: Breaking the Seal
strings.tm.s74.body: You strike it. The stone does not break: it answers. The mist rises to the height of your mouth, like a hand closing.
strings.tm.s74.c1: Step back to catch your breath
strings.tm.s74.c3: Throw salt to gain a moment
strings.tm.s75.title: The Passage Opens
strings.tm.s75.body: Something gives way. A panel slides aside. Behind it: a tunnel climbing toward real light. You feel outside air.
strings.tm.s75.c2: Make sure nothing is following you before leaving
strings.tm.s75.c3: Look behind you for one second
strings.tm.s76.title: The Final Temptation
strings.tm.s76.body: When you look back, the ossuary seems almost soothing. Calm. Sacred. Part of you wants to stay, as if this place had always kept a place for you.
strings.tm.s76.c1: Do not look and keep climbing
strings.tm.s77.title: The Exit
strings.tm.s77.body: The tunnel leads to an opening hidden beneath rocks. Hot air hits you. You fall to your knees, gasping. And you still feel cold inside your chest.
strings.tm.s77.c1: Head to camp without looking back
strings.tm.s77.c3: Look at the ground: your footprints…
strings.tm.s78.title: The Impossible Footprints
strings.tm.s78.body: Your footprints form a perfect loop. As if you had gotten out and come back without remembering it. And your breath makes little clouds, as though the air were growing colder the more you understand.
strings.tm.s78.c1: Return to camp no matter what
strings.tm.s78.c2: Go back and seal the temple
strings.tm.s79.title: Understanding
strings.tm.s79.body: At last, you understand what is happening here. This place erases people. That is why the missing never come back.
strings.tm.s79.c2: Leave the site as fast as possible
strings.tm.s80.title: The Final Choice
strings.tm.s80.body: You are finally outside. Now you can warn the camp, return to seal this place, or accept the pact.
strings.tm.s80.c2: Go back to seal the temple
strings.tm.end_good.title: Ending — The Escape
strings.tm.end_good.body: You run back to camp and tell them what you lived through. They only half believe you… but they shut the site down. That night, you barely sleep. Every time you breathe too loudly, you think you feel cold mist at the edge of your lips.
strings.tm.end_bad.title: Ending — Swallowed
strings.tm.end_bad.body: You return to seal it. The slab moves by itself. The mist rises slowly. You breathe in — and understand too late that this was what it had been waiting for. Inside the chamber, a new bone takes its place.
strings.tm.end_secret.title: Secret Ending — Ash Contract
strings.tm.end_secret.body: You speak a name. The seal answers. The exit opens like a mouth letting you go. But the cold mark remains on you. From now on, you are no longer quite the same. And you know that one day, she will call you back.
strings.tm.clue.has_salt.title: Pouch of Salt
strings.tm.clue.has_salt.desc: A small pouch of dry salt, left behind as an obvious protection.
strings.tm.clue.has_codex.title: Codex Page
strings.tm.clue.has_codex.desc: An intact page describing the rule: name in exchange for exit, breath in exchange for damnation.
strings.tm.clue.has_jade.title: Jade Bead
strings.tm.clue.has_jade.desc: A cold bead, too perfect, found in the skull alcoves.
strings.tm.clue.has_obsidian.title: Obsidian Knife
strings.tm.clue.has_obsidian.desc: A shaped obsidian piece, used as a key for the door / the mechanism.
strings.tm.clue.has_name.title: Chosen Name
strings.tm.clue.has_name.desc: A name offered or stolen to activate the seal.
strings.tm.clue.has_offering.title: Offering Ready
strings.tm.clue.has_offering.desc: You have prepared a coherent ritual offering, ready to calm the temple and complete the rite.
strings.tm.h.s09.soft: The salt is not there just to look pretty.
strings.tm.h.s09.strong: Take the salt: it is especially useful against the mist, in a few narrow passages, and during moments when the temple is still hesitating.
strings.tm.h.s14.soft: What explains the rules is worth more than gold.
strings.tm.h.s14.strong: Take the codex: it reveals the rule of breath and unlocks the “clean” path.
strings.tm.h.s28.soft: This obsidian is placed like a key.
strings.tm.h.s28.strong: Take the obsidian knife: it opens the stone door and is used in the mechanism.
strings.tm.h.s63.soft: The seal is an exit… but not a free one.
strings.tm.h.s63.strong: Clean exit = objects + chosen name. Avoid “giving your breath.”
strings.tm.h.s80.strong: Secret ending: chosen name, complete offering, and the rule understood through the codex.
